Job visibility dashboard

Repository

Fresh — alerted in the last 24 hours

Jobs emitted by the latest GitHub alert Issues, including newly found A/B jobs and B→A promotions. This mirrors automation activity rather than posted_date or original first_seen.

Rolling — newly found in the last 3 days

Current A/B (or Syncareer kept) candidates, ranked Tier A first, then discovery time and score.

In Progress

Jobs you are actively preparing or following up on.

Applied / Completed

Applied jobs leave the active Fresh and Rolling lists.

Deleted — last 7 days

Deleted jobs stay recoverable in this browser for one week, then disappear.

Referral opportunities

Optional view. Aliases come only from source/target_companies.json.

Official company search links

Quick official searches for manual checks and future adapters. “Automated” entries already have a scraper; “link only” entries are intentionally not reverse-engineered yet.
